description.html: Arcadia Solar Basking Spotlight 100W is a heat bulb that creates a warm basking spot in the terrarium. Arcadia says its Solar Basking lamps emit mostly infrared energy (mainly IR-A), and the packaging of this bulb states that it also provides UVA, which aids well-being and colour vision in reptiles. It screws into a standard E27 socket.

The 100 W rating is the strongest Arcadia spot bulb in our range, intended for larger and taller terrariums and species that need a hot basking spot, such as bearded dragons and other desert lizards. In a smaller terrarium it can quickly overheat the space.

Fit the bulb in a ceramic socket on one side of the terrarium, so there is a warm basking zone and a cooler side for resting. The manufacturer recommends using it with a thermostat and alongside species-appropriate UVB lighting, because a spot bulb does not provide UVB. Check the basking temperature with a thermometer and adjust the lamp height or wattage to suit your animal.
